meta.title: Kotek weighs in on Portland school closures as backlash reaches governor's office
meta.author: KGW News
meta.description:
In a letter, Gov. Tina Kotek is urging Portland Public Schools to slow down and give families more time to have their say before closing 14 schools.

Read more: https://www.kgw.com/article/news/education/governor-tina-kotek-portland-public-schools-letter-closure-plan-budget/283-e41fc4c9-0bdf-42ff-860f-64cb1a373881
